if({[.]TopCureTime_Longest.value}> 240,{[.]TopCureTime_Longest.value}+({[.]Gantry4TransportTime}*0.7), 302.4)
// The longest TopCure time determines the Recommended Infeed Delay time, limited to the equivalent of 100ppm.
tags.documentation:
TopCure2 Cure Time (x secs)+ Gantry4 Transport Time = Recommended Infeed Delay Time.

If the calculation produces a ppm value greater than 100, then limit the Recommended Infeed Delay Time to 302.4 to produce a ppm value of 100.
